gromgol_scout: Hanzo, scout. I work out of the north-west corner of Grom'gol, by the maps. I have walked this jungle as far south as the seam, where it stops being ours to name, and back. I do not recommend the walk. I do recommend knowing what is on it.
gromgol_signalman: Grut, signalman. My mast is at the north end of camp, under the zeppelin tower. Two flags means they are coming in. Three means they are not stopping. The airship is the only way home from here, so I watch it harder than I watch the wall.
gromgol_berth_master: Zekka, berth-master. I run de landing at de north end of Grom'gol. Everyt'ing you see in dis camp came off dat airship - every plank, every nail, every orc. Including me.
gromgol_cartographer: Ashi, mapmaker. My table is against the west wall of Grom'gol. The map is wrong. It is less wrong than it was. That is the job, and in this jungle it is a job that does not finish, because the jungle moves when I am not looking.
gromgol_flight_master: Pazzik, windrider-keeper. The roost is at the north-east of camp. Only one other roost worth flying to from here - Booty Bay, at the bottom of the jungle - and the Baron charges me to land on it.
gromgol_smith: Dorgun, smith. My anvil is on the east side of Grom'gol, as far from the water as the wall allows. Damp eats steel faster than any enemy I ever met. Bring me what has rusted and I will tell you whether it is worth saving.
gromgol_troll_attache: Zul'jana. Attache to de Overseer, which means I am de one in dis camp who is from here. You all keep calling it a jungle. It has a name. Several. Ask me properly and I might give you one.
gromgol_drillmaster: Ukko, drillmaster. This yard is the middle of Grom'gol. The Warchief sends me soldiers out of Durotar, and half of them have never fought anything that climbs. Everything here climbs.
gromgol_innkeeper: Rukha. The inn is the long tent on the west side of camp. Twelve bunks and a fire. Set your hearth here and the jungle stops being a one-way trip.
gromgol_wounded_runner: Teza. Runner, when I can run. Dey got me laid up on de west side by de medic. I made it back. Took de long way round de fen, out east, and I would do it again - but I left somet'ing out dere I should not have.
gromgol_field_medic: Sulaa, field medic. My ward is the south-west corner of Grom'gol. Bring them to me standing if you can. Bring them to me either way. Most of what I treat is not wounds. It is feet, and the water they have been standing in.
gromgol_commander: Overseer Mokra. I command Grom'gol, the Horde's only ground in Stranglethorn. The camp holds. That is the whole of my report to Orgrimmar and it has been for three years. I would like to send a different one before I am relieved.
gromgol_storesman: Pell, storesman. The stores are by the south wall. Count it in, count it out. The jungle takes what it wants in between, and I write that down as well, in a separate column.
gromgol_beast_handler: Kozza, beast-handler. De pens be at de south end of camp, by de gate. Dey are not tame. Dey are fed. Dere is a difference, and I respect it, and so will you if you want your hand back.
gromgol_south_sentry: Vrak. South gate of Grom'gol - the only way out on foot. The road is that way. Keep to it and the jungle mostly keeps to itself. The lagoon is south of here and the Green Cut east, and neither one is a road.
